observations: Three yellow and green retail boxes for 'Suman Breast Drill Machine' inside a larger cardboard carton.
The boxes specify a 1/2 inch (13mm) capacity and a 'covered gear system with two speeds'.
The actual tools are not visible; only the packaging is shown.
The middle box has a visible tear/puncture on its left side.
The text on the boxes identifies the brand as Suman.

claims.evidence: The text on the boxes in photo 0 identifies the contents as breast drill machines.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain different/inferior items.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual drill machine outside of its box.

risks.risk: Internal gears may be seized, rusted, or stripped.
risks.proof: A video showing the handle being turned and the chuck rotating smoothly.

risks.risk: Essential components like the chuck key or side handles may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the tool with all included accessories laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the drill machine removed from the box to verify presence and external condition.
Video of the gears and chuck in motion to verify mechanical functionality.
Photo showing the chuck key and any detachable handles.
response.reason: The photo only shows the external packaging. It is impossible to verify the presence, condition, or completeness of the actual tools without seeing them outside the boxes.
